Dutch private equity firm HC Partners has almost doubled the size of its flagship fund after raising €100m for its third vehicle, exceeding its original €80m target and securing commitments from all of its existing institutional investors.

US private credit manager Foundation Credit has closed its second infrastructure debt fund at approximately $540m, a week after announcing a majority investment from fellow alternative asset manager New Holland Capital.

Three-quarters of private markets investors say the time required to receive distributions has increased over the past year, yet 84% still intend to increase their exposure to the asset class over the next two years, according to new research from Brown Brothers Harriman.

PGIM and LGT Capital Partners have co-led a $680m private credit continuation vehicle for US direct lender Tree Line Capital Partners, providing liquidity to existing investors in two of the manager's funds.

Mediobanca-owned alternative credit manager Polus Capital Management has raised about $600m to date for its second special situations fund, having returned to capital raising after deploying almost all of its €890m predecessor.

KKR has completed its first private credit continuation vehicle with more than $460m in commitments, joining a growing number of alternative asset managers using secondary transactions to provide liquidity to investors in ageing direct lending funds.

The proportion of insurers planning to increase private markets allocations has fallen by 18 percentage points in a year, despite most still expecting to invest more in the asset class, according to new research from BlackRock.
